name: DuelLab GameBench 2
preferred_description: DuelLab GameBench 2 evaluates AI-generated game-playing programs through deterministic head-to-head matches. Match outcomes, not human or AI judges, produce the ratings. Public standings, methodology, and release data are available; the evaluator, engine implementation, and unpublished operational artifacts remain private.
comparison_boundary: GameBench 1 and GameBench 2 use different game sets and evaluation contexts; their scores and ranks are not directly comparable.
